snip.t: "Sepsis Mimics": Non-infectious causes of acute high fever include thyroid storm, heat stroke, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, and severe drug reactions (DRESS).
Heat stroke: Life-threatening thermoregulatory failure with hyperthermia and CNS dysfunction (confusion, seizures or coma); may cause rhabdomyolysis, acute kidney/liver injury and coagulopathy.
snip.s: MKU Human Physiology IV Main Examination 2026/2027: Questions and Answers

snip.t: Clinical emergency: Suspected heat stroke requires immediate rapid active cooling and urgent emergency medical care.
snip.s: MKU Human Physiology IV Main Examination 2026/2027: Questions and Answers

snip.t: Causes: inadequate replacement of hypotonic fluid loss, osmotic diuresis (diabetes), decreased ADH secretion, high fever, heat stroke, massive diarrhoea
SLE), temperature extremes (heat stroke, burns), infections (meningococci, rickettsiae), and endotoxaemia
